metadata.source: 気象庁 地上気象観測平年値 (1991–2020)

elements.kion: 月別 0600 日最高気温の月平均 (°C)

derived.method: The twelve monthly 日最高気温 normals are anchored at each month's midpoint and interpolated with a cyclic Catmull-Rom spline; natsuKaishi/natsuOwari are the days that curve crosses the threshold and natsuPeak is its maximum.
derived.caveat: These days are DERIVED, not announced. JMA publishes no 猛暑の初日 the way it publishes 梅雨入り or 初雪, and a day named by crossing a curve fitted to monthly means carries roughly ±5–10 days of slop. The shape of the season is the source's; the edges are this script's reading of it.

metadata.note: 1991–2020 normals. Fifty-six of the 157 surface stations never reach a 30 °C monthly mean daily maximum — all of Hokkaido, most of the Tohoku coast, the summit stations, and 昭和 (Syowa, Antarctica), which is in JMA's surface network and is excluded.
